$comment: S07 NASA POWER daily point (T056). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s07.yaml.

fields.name: cell_id
fields.meaning: power_<lat>N_<lon>E, the requested point echoed in geometry.coordinates (POWER returns no source cell)

fields.name: date_local
fields.meaning: UTC day from the parameter keys (time-standard=UTC is requested and checked in the header)

fields.name: met_product
fields.meaning: MERRA2 or GEOSIT from header.sources; one per response (mixed responses are split or refused)

fields.name: solar_product
fields.meaning: SRB or SYN1DEG from header.sources; null when the response has no solar value

fields.name: api_version
fields.meaning: header.api.version, cited with the data as POWER asks

fields.name: tmean_c
fields.meaning: T2M, daily mean temperature at 2 m, C

fields.name: solar_missing_reason
fields.meaning: Why solar_mj_m2 is null (not_yet_available, out_of_coverage, quality_rejected); solar lags rain and temperature by months

valid_at: the end of the UTC day
missing: -999 (header fill_value) is null. Rain or temperature missing makes the row all-null for both with missing_reason (not_yet_available after the newest complete day, else out_of_coverage); negative rain gives quality_rejected. Solar has its own solar_missing_reason
